title: Igenamiterere
networkSimulationHint: Kora nta murandasi, ongeramo gutinda cyangwa amakosa, wigane impinduka z'abandi
aboutText: CareConnect y'Umujyanama ni igerageza rikoresha amakuru y'igerageza gusa. Ntirikoreshwa mu buvuzi.
signedOut: Wasohotse. Ibitarahujwe bigumye kuri iki gikoresho.
offlineSimHint: Impinduka zibikwa kuri iki gikoresho kandi nta kintu cyoherezwa.
revokeDeviceHint: Byerekana ibiba iyo umugenzuzi ahagaritse igikoresho cyabuze
revokeDescription: Guhuza birahagarara kandi amakuru y'abarwayi arahishwa. Ibitarahujwe bigumye kuri iki gikoresho kandi ntibyoherezwa.
resetDemoHint: Subiza amakuru y'igerageza ya mbere kuri iki gikoresho
clockDrift: Isaha y'igikoresho itandukanye n'iya seriveri ho iminota {{minutes}} — ibihe winjiza biracyabikwa
encryption: Amakuru kuri iki gikoresho abikwa adahishwe muri iri gerageza. Expo Go ntishobora guhisha ububiko bw'imbere; porogaramu nyayo ikenera ububiko buhishwe.

reset.title: Subiza igerageza ku ntangiriro
reset.intro: Ibi bisubiza amakuru y'igerageza ya mbere kuri iki gikoresho no kuri seriveri yiganwa, bisubiza isaha y'igerageza kandi bigusohora. Ururimi wahisemo rugumaho.
reset.nothingPending: Nta kintu gitegereje guhuzwa kuri iki gikoresho.
reset.typeHint: Andika ijambo RESET mu nyuguti nkuru kugira ngo buto ikore.
reset.mismatch: Andika RESET neza kugira ngo buto ikore.
reset.loading: Birimo kubara ibiri kuri iki gikoresho…

activity.title: Amateka y'ibikorwa
activity.intro: Ibikorwa byanditswe kuri iki gikoresho n'ibyaturutse kuri seriveri yiganwa. Gusoma gusa.
